verified_behaviors.conclusion: Pending ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS reuses the original command identity and copied context for byte-stable envelopes. Transport/admission cannot settle the execution. Interrupted pre-admission send does not start a task.

Whole-page shape/scope/build validation precedes emission, cursor/watermark continuity and bounded history are enforced, duplicate sequence bytes are checked, >200 events paginate, gaps/foreign/changed/stuck cursors fail closed. CURSOR_INVALID emits the actual snapshot and returns unresolved instead of treating missing events as success.

New admission is associated with its returned Goal, unique canonical Task and eventual active Run; project/task/run and current session target are rechecked. Old terminal events cannot settle that task. This intentionally supports the current finite one-task NORMAL path, not arbitrary multi-task Goal execution.

Exit 0 requires SETTLED canonical Run with real execution_report, exit_code 0, nonempty result_artifact_ids whose same-Run AVAILABLE events were consumed; canonical and projected revisions/status/children/queue/settled timestamps must match. Result explicitly states independent acceptance NOT_EVALUATED. FAILED and confirmed CANCELLED have separate exits.

Signals record intent. Initial missing Run keeps following original Task; host CANCEL is sent once after exact Run binding with current session authority. Cancellation only returns 130 after matching confirmed terminal state with children/queue stopped; unknown/no-run deadlines retain original identities and exit non-success.

Input reader dispatches complete multiline text before stdin EOF. Synchronous turn follower prevents a second NORMAL active writer. Slash goal/run/resume/status/cancel use actual handlers; model/help use existing handlers; resulting session context is saved on blocked outcomes as well.
Follow path transport rejects oversized/incomplete replies, non-2xx, command/method/protocol identity mismatches and redirects; host typed resource/authority/usage failures map to non-success.

evidence_assessment.reason_not_rerun: All 425 recorded source inputs and CLI source snapshots match unchanged candidate; raw result/hash and counterexamples were independently read; no new concrete unresolved S1 concern justified rerunning old checks.

integration_boundaries.finding: Empty CLI context only adopts session identity for session.create, and only session.send enters the execution follower. goal.start envelope support alone therefore does not retain an auto-created Goal session or follow Goal execution. Host Goal implementation and later exact CLI integration are still required; root and Goal implementer were notified.

No-Run Task/Goal cancellation, mid-run slash/STEER/FOLLOW_UP, full TUI, token streaming, real tool projection and nested SDK identity remain unqualified. Resume remains its existing attach/control/read flow, not a general Goal terminal follower.

CLI does not independently read private EffectLog. Canonical host report/recovery owns effectsReconciled. Expired/missing writer authority or disconnected observations must remain unresolved; package pass does not prove long-running lease renewal.
Six CLI product paths do not change the established W04 domain source vector, but integration must retain parent formal status and existing histories; this review does not sign parent acceptance.
